review_kind: All authored-procedure packages (83 direct + 3 nested) as complete exact pinned packages, individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: The 83 direct-shape packages with authored sections beyond the catalog template, plus three nested first-class DocsBot reference SKILL.md files, were reviewed as complete packages including all bundled scripts, references, templates, licenses and attribution files (docsbot-administration 49 files, gauntlet 21, clean-closed-issue-worktrees 7, goal-instruction-writer 7, sell-unused-tokens 6, concept-to-story 6).

Strongest reusable mechanisms: explicit scan-confirm-execute with exact plan IDs (clean-closed-issue-worktrees 19/20), per-action confirmation for publishing and phone calls (shipvela-publish, placecall, bulkpublish), privacy-preserving style learning (email-voice), read-only-by-default bounded review loop with a local-only SQLite tracker (gauntlet).

Authority hard gate failed for 16 packages: unconfirmed production USDC sales (usdctofiat-cashout), metered checkout/cancellations with a raw private key (zinc-universal-checkout), git push origin master under a coordination lock only (autonomous-session-workflow), account creation and public profile publishing (xletter, cooper-email), webhook registration on provider accounts (openhook), active pentest launch without confirm-before-launch (darkmoon-pentest-mcp), trading with upstream-only gates (hypergrok-trading-desk), harness security reconfiguration (hol-guard).

Four packages fetch and follow remote instructions or self-overwrite (datacircle "Read https://datacircle.dev/SKILL.md and follow it", install-and-write-faber-romanus, keep-claude-code-skills-current-from-real-sessions-with-autoharness, aident-loadout); recorded as self-update-or-remote-code and rejected.

Most authored packages route the agent to the author's paid or hosted service and install from unpinned sources (@latest, npx -y, upstream main); vendor lock-in is recorded per package and does not by itself fail review.

Package-local licenses override the root MIT for some packages (goal-instruction-writer, concept-to-story, gauntlet, openhook, usdctofiat-cashout MIT; xletter MIT-0); sandbase claims Apache-2.0 upstream without shipping text and DocsBot bot-builder templates self-describe as copies of vendor internal source, both recorded as license-conflict.

Three packages are DEFER because an essential bundled client referenced by SKILL.md is absent from the pinned package (live-search-console-data scripts/refreshagent_api.py, brainiall-diarized-transcription scripts/transcribe.mjs, popnow-video helper at an upstream commit); they are not counted as terminal decisions.

Publisher "security_reviewed" labels on authored packages (e.g. tenancy-development, constrain-coding-agent-over-defense-with-hero, autoharness, AIHawk, PR Lens) are unsupported by any evidence in the packages.

records.content_finding: Unusually thorough, evidence-driven build procedure with hard readiness gates, read-back verification and a scoring rubric, and good secret hygiene. However it is sprawling and repetitive (labels rule restated many times), vendor-locked, and several outward-facing writes (webhook test deliveries, Slack/Help Scout routing, public bot creation) lack per-action confirmation, while some defaults (piiRedaction off, saveMeta on) and sales template phrases trade privacy/honesty for conversion.
records.bundled_file_findings: No scripts. agents/openai.yaml: Codex display metadata, default prompt, MCP dependency on https://mcp.docsbot.ai. assets/prompts/*.md: seven prompt templates (customer-support, sales-agent, ai-agent, helpscout, voice-support/receptionist/sales) with placeholders; contain grounding and tool-privacy rules plus some sales-pressure sample phrases. references/: workflow.md (intake, research, branding, sources, tags, handoff), operations.md (named tool/field map, deep links), source-types.md, prompt-instructions.md, branding/appearance.md & widget.md (luminance formula, contrast check, CDN-only upload URLs), deployment/surfaces/slack/helpscout-auto-drafting/voice.md, actions/index + billing/custom-buttons/escalation/external-mcp/lead-collection/scheduling/skills-library/web-search/webhooks.md, sources/connectors.md & document-uploads.md, evaluation/rubric.md (100-pt rubric with critical/major defects), handoff/final.md. References internal vendor source paths (src/lib/voiceAgent.js) not in package; non-essential.
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: Writes to the user's DocsBot account are the requested activity (create_bot, update_bot, create_source, set tags/refresh, configure Skills, register external MCP servers, update Slack routing, configure Help Scout routing, create webhooks). Gated: destructive writes, integration disconnects, source/bot deletion, member changes require summarize-and-confirm unless exact action pre-authorized; Help Scout publishReply (auto-sending customer emails) only on explicit user approval; Advanced voice/voice Skills/MCP only on explicit request; refunds/cancellations not enabled without policy rules; write-capable external MCP tools not run during setup without explicit authorization; search_bot_knowledge only when authorized. Not separately gated: send_test_*_webhook deliveries to external endpoints, create_webhook, update_slack_routing, configure_helpscout_integration and public-privacy bot creation proceed under the general build request; list_team_integrations with revealWebhookSecret pulls a secret into agent context (told not to print). Privacy: strong redaction rules for tokens, signature keys, signed URLs; asks credentials out of band, not in chat. Concerns: recommends saveMeta true (stores Help Scout customer name/email as model context) and keeps piiRedaction false by default for public bots; Help Scout template tells the model to write 'as if we have already taken that action' (safe only in draft mode); sales template sample phrases ('I can reserve that discount for you today', 'Shall I email you a quote?') conflict with its own no-invented-commitments rules.

records.content_finding: Strong evidence discipline for RAG diagnosis: logged sources as ground truth for model context, live retrieval reproduction, unsupported-vs-false distinction, and a prompt-controllability check that keeps prompt edits from papering over data gaps. Gate: 'Ask before mutations that change sources, prompts, models, or integrations unless the user already authorized that exact fix'; destructive log/conversation deletion requires confirmation; glossary update asks first; handoff explicitly asks whether to apply. Privacy: redact/minimize customer PII in summaries, quote only needed excerpts, do not paste customer PII from logs into new public sources, flag bot replies leaking secrets/PII as critical. search_question_logs/search_bot_knowledge embed queries (vendor-side processing of log text).
